summary: Build practical qualitative analysis skills for M&E using coding, framework analysis, NVivo workflows, and evidence-based reporting. Enrol today.
lede: Qualitative analysis training helps monitoring and evaluation professionals turn interview and focus group material into evidence-backed findings. It is for analysts, evaluation specialists and programme managers who need to explain outcomes and inform programme decisions. Participants practise building codebooks, comparing themes in framework matrices and checking findings against indicator and administrative data.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who collect, manage, analyse, or commission qualitative evidence for monitoring, evaluation, research, learning, and programme decision-making. It supports foundation-level analysts who want a structured workflow and intermediate practitioners who need to improve consistency, transparency, and reporting quality.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with monitoring and evaluation, programme logic, interviews, surveys, or field research is recommended. No prior qualitative analysis software experience or programming knowledge is required. You should bring a laptop for template-based exercises. Advanced software configuration and technical coding are outside the course scope.
